subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make OpenAI-compatible endpoints ignore or tolerate a generic request body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first body model contract?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the choice changes public API semantics for model selection and needs a parity decision across Chat Completions, Responses, and embeddings.

options.title: Adopt header precedence broadly
options.body: Treat the body model as client compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, and update shared code, docs, and tests for all chosen OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

options.title: Preserve agent-first body models
options.body: Keep requiring `model` to be an OpenClaw agent target and document SDK integrations to send `openclaw/default` or `openclaw/<agentId>` with the optional header.

options.title: Decide shared semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until Gateway owners choose the cross-endpoint precedence rule, then implement that single contract consistently.

recommendation.title: Decide shared semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Gateway owners choose the cross-endpoint precedence rule, then implement that single contract consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the agent-first OpenAI-compatible model contract and the adjacent models/embeddings expansion this issue would modify.
